description: Removal of two roof lanterns and installation of roof windows; replacement of the glazed doors of the rear infill extension
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (PR-A0.01; PR-A1.01; PR-A1.02; PR-A2.01; PR-A3.01 Received:  25 June 2020;  EX-A0.01; EX-A1.01; EX-A1.02; EX-A2.01; EX-A3.01; LO-A-01; LO-A-02  Received:  22 June 2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be installed in the single storey rear infill extension approved by Planning Permission 01176/25/P1 as altered by the proposals hereby approved.
